**Your AI agents forget everything between sessions. Firm fixes that.**

138 MCP tools · 4-layer Hebbian memory · A2A Protocol · 15 sectors · 47 security checks

[Quick Start](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/firm-ecosystem#quick-start-2-minutes) · [Docs](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/firm-ecosystem/tree/main/docs) · [Examples](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/firm-ecosystem/tree/main/examples) · [Contributing](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/firm-ecosystem/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

### Install in 30 seconds

```bash
pip install firm-cli
firm init --sector fintech --size startup --output ./my-firm
firm start
```

### Repositories

| Repo | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [**firm-ecosystem**](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/firm-ecosystem) | Main repo — CLI, MCP server, skills, factory |
| [**Memory-os-ai**](https://github.com/romainsantoli-web/Memory-os-ai) | Standalone Hebbian memory engine (18 MCP tools) |
